name: Eternal Security
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that those who believe in Jesus Christ receive everlasting life and are securely kept by Him. Jesus promises that all who come to Him will never be cast out, and His sheep are known and protected so that no one can snatch them from His hand. This eternal security is affirmed by the assurance that believers have passed from death to life and will not face condemnation, supported by the conviction that no force in heaven or on earth can separate them from God's love.
